title: Local finite presentation under a ring-object isomorphism
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and let $R,S$ be commutative ring objects in $\Sh(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\Ab)$ with the sheaf tensor product [sk-def-sfb-ring-object]. Let $\varphi:R\xrightarrow{\sim}S$ be an isomorphism of ring objects. Use module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], finite presentations [def-sfb-finitely-presented-module], and local finite presentations [def-sfb-locally-finitely-presented]. Restriction of scalars $\operatorname{Res}_\varphi$ [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars] preserves and reflects local finite presentation. More precisely, for every $S$-module $N$, a pro-étale covering family witnesses local finite presentation of $N$ if and only if the same family witnesses it for $\operatorname{Res}_\varphi N$; the finite presentation ranks can be kept unchanged. Equivalently, $\operatorname{Ext}_\varphi$ preserves and reflects local finite presentation of $R$-modules, with the same covers and ranks.

proof.text: Restriction along $\varphi$ preserves finite colimits by the restriction/coextension adjunction [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]. In the abelian sheaf category [lem-sfb-grothendieck-sheafification], with closed tensor [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor], Mod.finiteFreeIsoComap identifies $\operatorname{Res}_\varphi(S^k)$ with $R^k$. For a fixed map $f:S^m\to S^n$, conjugate $\operatorname{Res}_\varphi(f)$ by these comparisons. PreservesCokernel.iso and cokernel.mapIso identify the restricted cokernel with the cokernel of this conjugate. Composing the image of a presentation isomorphism proves the fixed-rank forward implication [def-sfb-finitely-presented-module]. Apply the same construction along $\varphi^{-1}$ and compose with the unit of Mod.comapEquivalenceOfIsIso [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars] for reflection. This is the fixed-rank version of the existing source-library proof Mod.IsFinitelyPresented.comap; no general scalar-extension finite-presentation theorem is needed.

For each member $u_i$ of a fixed pro-étale cover, set $F=u_i^*$. The lax monoidal structure underlying [def-sfb-finite-upper-star-monoidal] sends $\varphi$ to an isomorphism of monoid objects. The fixed-rank restriction calculation in step 1 does not require commutativity, so no braidedness of $F$ is needed here. The identity-coefficient case of the restriction/transport comparison [def-sfb-comap-mapmod-square] is already supplied by Functor.mapModComapIso: $F(\operatorname{Res}_\varphi N)\cong\operatorname{Res}_{F\varphi}(FN)$. Apply step 1 to $F\varphi$ and compose presentation isomorphisms with this comparison. This proves equivalence for every specified cover member and both specified ranks. Quantifying the ranks and the unchanged cover gives the local finite-presentation equivalence [def-sfb-locally-finitely-presented].

For an $R$-module $M$, let $e:\operatorname{Ext}_\varphi M\cong\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi^{-1}}M$ be the component of Mod.extendScalarsIsoComapInv [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]. Apply step 2 to $\varphi^{-1}$. Pull $e$ back on every member of the unchanged cover and compose its inverse with the resulting presentation isomorphisms. Composition with an isomorphism preserves the witness map and both ranks [def-sfb-finitely-presented-module]; existential quantification gives the local assertion too [def-sfb-locally-finitely-presented].

proof_origin.place: Coefficient relabelling paragraph, implemented by the source-library finiteFreeIsoComap and cokernel comparisons rather than general extension of scalars; pullback compatibility and inverse restriction finish the same-cover clauses.
